notes: fact: Pires puts the departure from Gujarat, not arrival in Melaka, in March (Pires II, pp. 269–270). See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §1.
inference: April–May is an estimated arrival and quick-turnaround window; October is a low-weight alternative, not a regular second fleet. See docs/research/monsoon-calendar.md, §1.
gameplay: Relative weights and month preferences are authored tuning, not observed traffic or compulsory departure dates.
